rows.text: when `rdx` and `r8` are both non-null, replaces float `[rdx]` with float `rcx+0x4664` times it minus 1.65 (`008F9DD0`) and float `[r8]` with float `rcx+0x4668` times it minus 2.0 (`01CEBC08`); otherwise returns without writing

when qword `rcx+8` is below qword `rcx+0x10` (unsigned), advances `+8` by 0x230 and, when the old value is non-null, calls `001C2D50` + 0x34 with it in `rcx` and the incoming `rdx`; otherwise tail-jumps (`001C2D50` + 0x49) with `rcx`, qword `+8` in `rdx` and the incoming `rdx` in `r8`

with ints `r8d`, `r9d` and the fifth and sixth (stack) arguments c and d: when `r8d` equals c and `r9d` equals d, stores 0 into dwords `[rdx]` and `[rcx]`; otherwise, when float c divided by float d exceeds float `r8d` divided by float `r9d`, stores the absolute value of (`r8d` minus c) divided by 2 (signed, truncated) into `[rcx]` and 0 into `[rdx]`, else stores 0 into `[rcx]` and the absolute value of (`r9d` minus d) divided by 2 into `[rdx]`
